item.text: {"search_note":"I found no strong 2024 evidence of Biden actively strengthening independent courts or legislatures when they constrained him. The best support for 4B.4 is narrower: DOJ-led accountability for local police, formal civilian-harm oversight, and audit-body scrutiny. The record is much thinner on affirmative court- or legislature-strengthening actions.","evidence":[{"title":"GAO says DOD and State built civilian-harm response processes, with DOD implementing all CHMR-AP objectives by Dec. 16, 2024","publisher":"U.S. Government Accountability Office","date":"2025-04-24","url":"https://files.gao.gov/reports/GAO-25-107077/index.html","summary":"A congressional audit found the administration had created formal processes to respond to civilian-harm reports and that DOD was in the final phases of implementing the full civilian-harm mitigation plan by late 2024. This is the clearest evidence of strengthening oversight infrastructure.","question_ids":["4B.4","3B.7"]},{"title":"DOJ finds Phoenix police violated civil rights","publisher":"U.S. Department of Justice","date":"2024-06-13","url":"https://www.justice.gov/archives/opa/pr/justice-department-finds-civil-rights-violations-phoenix-police-department-and-city-phoenix","summary":"Biden’s DOJ publicly investigated and condemned unconstitutional policing by a local government, showing federal oversight of a subordinate institution rather than shielding it from scrutiny.","question_ids":["4B.4","3B.8","3B.9"]},{"title":"DOJ announces Louisville policing consent decree","publisher":"U.S. Department of Justice","date":"2024-12-12","url":"https://www.justice.gov/archives/opa/speech/assistant-attorney-general-kristen-clarke-delivers-remarks-announcing-consent-decree","summary":"DOJ reached a court-enforceable reform decree after finding violations in Louisville, which is direct evidence of using oversight and judicially supervised remedies to constrain a local government.","question_ids":["4B.4","3B.8","3B.9"]},{"title":"DOD issues civilian-harm mitigation instruction","publisher":"U.S. Department of Defense","date":"2024-02-13","url":"https://www.defense.gov/News/News-Stories/Article/Article/3624268/dod-issues-civilian-harm-mitigation-response-instruction/","summary":"DOD formalized oversight, incident review, training, and senior civilian supervision for civilian-harm mitigation. This is internal institutional strengthening, though not as strong as independent external oversight.","question_ids":["4B.4","3B.7"]},{"title":"GAO says civilian-harm oversight was still incomplete and not fully independent","publisher":"U.S. Government Accountability Office","date":"2025-04-24","url":"https://files.gao.gov/reports/GAO-25-107077/index.html","summary":"The same audit found CHIRG would not accept non-government reports and that State had not completed investigations into credible reports by Dec. 2024. That weakens the case for robust, independent oversight.","question_ids":["4B.4","3B.7"]},{"title":"Reuters: police were advised to avoid mass arrests, then came the US campus protests","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-05-10","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/police-were-advised-to-avoid-mass-arrests-then-came-the-us-campus-protests-3433913","summary":"This is the strongest counterexample in the 2024 record: a large protest wave met mass arrests despite advice to avoid that approach, suggesting a coercive local-enforcement climate rather than consistently strengthening rights-protective institutions.","question_ids":["4B.4","3B.8","3B.9"]},{"title":"Washington Post: more than 2,000 campus arrests in a short span","publisher":"The Washington Post","date":"2024-05-03","url":"https://www.washingtonpost.com/nation/interactive/2024/university-antiwar-campus-protests-arrests-data/?itid=lk_fullstory&itid=lk_inline_manual_26&itid=lk_inline_manual_5","summary":"The protest environment featured riot-police tactics, tear gas, tasers, and stun grenades at scale. That undercuts a broad claim that the administration reliably encouraged independent civil-society monitoring or noncoercive local governance.","question_ids":["4B.4","3B.8","3B.9"]}]}
